tagline: Paint a little city and watch it grow month by month. Invite a co-mayor.
description:
The city is saved in the file — close it, share the GIF, and the streets are still there. Press Invite in the bar above the app and a friend is co-mayor on the same land, live.

Paint homes, shops and works. Run a plant and a river pump. Time ticks in months you can watch: buildings grow when the city works, people walk the roads to jobs, windows light up at night. Cut the power, jack the tax, or isolate a neighbourhood, and they leave. Tap Look and a lot will tell you why it will not grow.

Inspired by SimCity (Maxis / Electronic Arts). This is our own engine and our own pictures — not a port of theirs.
